name: CN_RS_RULE_EVENTS_ALL
description: This table holds all the events logged for classification and crediting rules.

columns.name: RULE_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Unique event identifier.

columns.name: RULE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to cn_rs_rules_all_b.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: USAGE_ID
columns.description: Indicates whether the rule is for classification or crediting.

columns.name: RANK_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the rank should be calculated for the rule.

columns.name: HIERARCHY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the rule should be denormalized.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the qualifiers values should be generated fot the rule.

columns.name: DELETE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the rule should be deleted.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the rule or assignment.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the rule or assignment.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of modification done to the rule.

columns.name: DEPLOY_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates the deploy status of the rule.

columns.name: EVENT_DETAIL_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates the event detail status of the rule.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
